equivalent-formulation.title: Adjustment sets in the running four-node graph
equivalent-formulation.caption: Toggle nodes in and out of Z. The panel re-derives which paths stay open, so the graphical criterion settles the question without any density.
equivalent-formulation.prompt: Estimate G offers Z = {A} for the pair (C, D) in the true graph H. Valid or not?

params.title: Is Z = {A} a valid adjustment set for (C, D)?
betOptions: Not valid — a non-causal path stays open
Valid — A closes everything that matters
params.betReveal: B is a parent of C in H but is not in Z, so the fork C ← B → D stays open. Click B to add it and the path closes.
